scope.excluded: Third-party engine/OS internals; booleans that are independent facts or preferences are not workflow machines.
scope.definition: App-owned workflows with competing events or async owners; independent facts/preferences and SDK/third-party internals are not converted into artificial enums.

workflows.invariant: Pinch-held geometry and free scroll; restoration applies only after real inner/outer viewport layout, and nested geometry updates cannot publish provisional positions.
workflows.persistence: Durable page/fraction, zoom/pan, page aspect and legal document-margin point survive restart. Pending saved positions remain authoritative until applied or superseded by a user gesture.

workflows.invariant: Capture the departing/current screen before encoding, including navigation and lifecycle boundaries; hidden screens do not overwrite current progress.
workflows.persistence: Existing navigation, list anchor, playback checkpoint and reader position formats retained. Transient animation/output phases are rebuilt; cancellation never replaces a committed position with a temporary zero.

workflows.invariant: A saved sideways offset stays pending until collection bounds and item layout are usable; ordinary scrolling does not reapply it, and a new drag supersedes it.
workflows.persistence: The pending or live offset is captured in the existing gallery list state at navigation/lifecycle boundaries; the transient placement phase is rebuilt from that saved offset.

invariants: Free scrolling never snaps or waits for scroll-end to load content.
Zoom disables video carousel; only current video is visible at rest.
VOD neighbours are paused; live-stream neighbours remain muted.
Cancellation revokes only its owner; stale completions cannot publish or clear replacement work.
Manga current+next belongs only to touched series; retirement grace is 24 hours; covers and progress persist.
EOF, failure, stopping and paused intent remain distinct.
Foreground/background handoff has one authoritative owner.
Updates preserve bundle identities, credentials, source bytes and committed data.

reviewedStructuredOwners.representation: Reader barrier and task maps; absence means idle, a stored task is the sole shared owner; successful immutable metadata is committed separately.
One metadata task per gallery; durable immutable results survive process restart.
One coalesced route refresh task; ready table has an expiry, independent of download ownership.

reviewedStructuredOwners.ownership: First-frame position mirror, ordered actor persistence and lifecycle completion join; navigation owns capture-before-commit ordering.
